objective: maximize verified reduction in distance from the current repository state to a human-usable, persistent, end-to-end product state

capacityAllocation.rule: Allocation is measured over a rolling five-generation window. If the minimum structural allocation is missed, the next safe generation must prioritize structural work until compliance is restored.

mandatoryDecisionSequence: identify the product's primary user journey
determine whether a human can start or open the product
determine whether the primary journey completes end-to-end
determine whether results persist across restart or reopen
determine whether required real integrations operate
determine whether realistic failure and recovery paths work
decompose only enough to execute and verify it safely

allowedOnlyIf: it directly removes a blocker in the current primary journey
it is a required subcomponent of the selected structural workstream
it verifies or hardens a structural capability being integrated in the same generation
all higher-priority structural deficits are truly human-gated or unsafe

antiFragmentation.rule: A coherent product objective must remain one parent workstream even when decomposed into child tasks. Do not replace a structural change with an indefinite sequence of isolated screens, summaries, previews, guidance modules or dashboards.

accepted: a primary capability becomes usable by a human
a structural or architectural blocker is removed
a simulated capability is replaced by a real one
real persistence or integration is introduced
a substantive correctness, concurrency or recovery defect is fixed
the product becomes startable, deployable or directly testable
a previously failing realistic end-to-end test passes
rejected: query-only state standing in for required persistence
receipt generation without product utility delta
renaming or textual changes without functional effect

required: end-to-end or functional journey evidence when user-facing
explicit statement of what a human can now do that was previously impossible

valid: mutation or deletion of irreplaceable real data
genuinely ambiguous product decision not inferable from repository evidence
humanGateRule.rule: Complete all safe pre-gate work and request only the minimum precise human action required.

project-giovanni.primaryJourney: assessment -> plan -> workout -> result publication -> history -> progression

pfarma-cloud.primaryJourney: operator access -> real operational data -> action -> persistence -> audit and recovery
structuralPriorities: real inventory, reservations, customers, orders, documents, lots and expiries

family-cloud.primaryJourney: authenticate -> upload -> persist -> browse timeline and albums -> reopen -> recover and synchronize

beforeExecution: record parent workstream and acceptance evidence
afterIntegration: state what the human can now do
identify and immediately pursue the next structural bottleneck
cycleContract.stopRule: Do not stop at analysis, planning, queue creation, a merged child task or a nominal generation boundary. Stop only on execution-budget exhaustion, real backpressure, no safe useful work, or a true human gate.
